package.name: base101_autonomy
package.description: Composes base101_slam and base101_nav into one launch (and, on hardware, one forge component/container) — the two stacks are typically restarted together, so this avoids paying forge's per-container overhead twice. Exists specifically so that composition doesn't cost slam/nav their mutual independence (neither package depends on the other — see base101_slam/launch/slam.launch.py) and doesn't drag in base101_bringup_hw's full dependency chain (description/control/time/ agent) just to launch two files together.
